extensions.units: Native Android. px in tokens and snippets = dp for lengths, sp for text. Alpha colours are #RRGGBBAA here; Kotlin writes 0xAARRGGBB.

track-grey.source: MainActivity.kt TRACK (not IslandView.kt TRACK, which is island-track)

display.purpose: The settings title only. Typeface.DEFAULT at weight 600.

title.purpose: Switch and row labels (step titles at 500).

label.purpose: Chips and slider readouts at 500; row actions at 600.

readout.purpose: The stage's x/y/w/h readout, tabular figures.

island-compact.purpose: Left half of the compact pill; call caption.

island-compact-value.purpose: Right half of the compact pill, in the item's signal colour; chronometers.

island-meta.purpose: App name on a notification card.

fonts.name: island
fonts.value: Typeface.create("google-sans", NORMAL) at weights 400/600; Roboto fallback

fonts.name: settings
fonts.value: Typeface.create(Typeface.DEFAULT, weight, false) at 400/500/600; line spacing multiplier 1.15

effects.name: card-glow
effects.value: album art or caller photo, RenderEffect blur 48dp (CLAMP), alpha 0.6, center-crop
effects.purpose: Depth behind the music and call cards.

effects.name: card-scrim
effects.purpose: Keeps white text legible over the glow.

effects.name: notification-gradient
effects.value: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000000, hsv(h, s, 0.22), hsv(h, s, 0.48)); s clamped 0.45-0.85; hue from Notification.color, else icon dominant colour, else signal-blue

effects.name: music-accent
effects.value: album art scaled to 1x1, HSV value raised to at least 0.9; white without art

motion.name: spring-model
motion.value: w = 2π/response; v += (-w²(x-target) - 2·damping·w·v)·dt; 4ms substeps, frame dt capped at 48ms, divided by the system animator duration scale; settled when |x-target| < 0.5px and |v| < 10px/s
motion.purpose: Spring.kt / IslandView.frame(): the island's width and height.

motion.name: spring-grow
motion.purpose: Growing out of the camera: widens first, then drops; ~1.5% overshoot.

motion.name: spring-shrink
motion.purpose: Shrinking back: pulls up first, then narrows; no overshoot.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: EASE_OUT: every island content fade, scale, slide and press release.

motion.name: materialize-in
motion.value: alpha 0→1, scale 0.9→1, 240ms, 30ms delay, ease-out; blur 14px→0 over 240ms, 30ms delay

motion.name: shrink-hold
motion.purpose: The pill waits for content to fade before shrinking.

motion.name: compact-emerge
motion.value: halves translateX ±14dp→0, 320ms, 30ms delay, ease-out (back to ±14dp in 120ms on exit)
motion.purpose: The pill's two halves slide out of the camera.

motion.name: card-row-stagger
motion.value: each row alpha 0→1, translateY 8dp→0, 260ms, delay 60ms + 40ms × index, ease-out
motion.purpose: Card rows arrive one after another.

motion.name: pill-press
motion.value: scale 0.97 in 90ms, back to 1 in 220ms, ease-out

motion.name: drag
motion.value: 1:1 with finger; rubber band 0.25× past either end, capped at -0.05..1.05; release projects 200ms of velocity, commits past 0.5; finger velocity handed to the springs

motion.name: call-ripple
motion.value: two green rings, 1.8s period, half a period apart, ease-out radius, stroke 2dp→0, alpha 150→0

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: ValueAnimator.areAnimatorsEnabled() false: springs snap, blurs skipped, waveform static, ripple hidden, rock off

haptics.name: grow
haptics.purpose: The island grows to show something new (not for a chronometer gaining a digit).

haptics.name: long-press
haptics.purpose: Only when the item has an app to open.

haptics.name: fit-tick
haptics.purpose: Stage fitting: a value reaches or crosses 0, or hits the end of its range. Respects the Haptics switch.

narrative.overview:
Tab Island is one material in two places. On top of any app, it is a true-black pill grown out of the front camera, measured from the real cutout, that swells into cards for music, calls and messages and shrinks back into the hole on a spring. In the settings app, the same black becomes the page, and grey basalt slabs (each group "a small island") hold the switches. The settings screen is the island's fitting room: the real `IslandView` sits on a stage at 1:1 scale under a drawn camera ring, you drag it to fit, and every style plays on it from a chip.

The palette is monochrome on purpose. Black, basalt, bone and pumice do all the structural work; colour appears only as signal (green, orange, red, yellow, blue), each tied to a meaning, plus colour borrowed from content (album art, contact photos, an app's brand colour). Density is relaxed and thumb-first: 48dp chips and tabs, 56 to 64dp rows, a single column with a 16dp gutter.

Motion belongs to the island. It is the only thing that springs; the settings chrome moves only in short 150ms fades (the stage hint and the centre guide); chips swap in place and setup marks change without a pop. Every animation checks the system "Remove animations" setting.
keyCharacteristics: True black (#000000) island and page, never tinted at rest, never shadowed.
Basalt groups with inset seam hairlines instead of cards with shadows.
Monochrome controls: bone is "on/selected", ink is the thumb, pumice is secondary.
Pills everywhere: every tappable chip and tab is fully rounded.
Spring motion for the island's size, scale-and-blur materialising for its content.
Colour is signal or borrowed from content; never decoration.

rules.name: The True Black Rule
rules.body: The island is #000000 on screen, always (a brand commitment in PRODUCT.md). It may carry borrowed colour inside a card, but the pill itself is never tinted, lightened or given a border.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Each signal colour means one thing, on both surfaces. In settings, green appears only when something is on or done; a control is never green just to look active.

rules.name: The Monochrome Control Rule
rules.body: Settings controls are bone on basalt with ink thumbs. Selected and on are shown by bone fill, not by an accent colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes in place (chronometers, seek times, slider readouts, the x/y/w/h readout) uses tabular figures, so the pill and the readouts never jitter as digits change.

rules.name: The Flat Basalt Rule
rules.body: Settings surfaces separate by tone only (ink → basalt → seam). Never add a shadow, border or elevation to a group, chip or the stage.

rules.name: The Concentric Rule
rules.body: Anything sitting in the island's round end takes the pill's radius minus its inset, never a fixed radius of its own.

dos: **Do** keep the island and the settings ground at true black (#000000), and build settings structure from basalt slabs and seam hairlines only.
**Do** make every chip and tab a full pill at 48dp tall, and every list row at least 56dp.
**Do** use one meaning per signal colour: green on/done/answer/charging, orange timers and partial states, red decline and warnings, yellow flashlight, blue downloads and the notification fallback.
**Do** show selection and "on" in bone, with ink text or thumbs on it.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number that updates in place.
**Do** keep content in the island concentric with the pill's round end, and start card text below the camera band.
**Do** put new island motion on the springs (grow: responses 0.36s/0.46s, damping 0.8; shrink: 0.40s/0.30s, damping 1) and keep velocity across interruptions.
**Do** check the system "Remove animations" setting: springs snap, blurs are skipped, the waveform holds still and the ripple rings disappear.
**Do** give custom controls a TalkBack role and a state ("Calls, selected, button"; "+4 dp").
donts: **Don't** give the island a drop shadow, border or tint at rest; a shadow's margin becomes a dead touch zone over the app below.
**Don't** add shadows or elevation to settings groups, chips or the stage.
**Don't** colour a settings control with an accent to make it look active; green there means granted or running, nothing else.
**Don't** use a grey switch thumb; it sinks into the lighter off track. The thumb stays ink on both tracks.
**Don't** animate settings chrome with springs or long transitions; the island is the only thing that springs. Settings motion is limited to 150ms fades; chips and setup marks change in place.
**Don't** let a long label push the camera off-centre in the compact pill; both halves stay equal width and the text ellipsizes.
